gbm_population_evidence.quote: Recurrent High Grade Glioma; Anaplastic Astrocytoma; Anaplastic Oligodendroglioma; Glioblastoma; Gliosarcoma
Pathologically proven diagnosis of high grade (aka grade III or IV) glioma (anaplastic astrocytoma, anaplastic oligodendroglioma, glioblastoma, gliosarcoma)

candidate_evidence.quote: This study will determine the recommended dose and the side effects of PCI-24781/Abexinostat with metronomic temozolomide.

treatment_setting_evidence.quote: A Phase I Study of Metronomic Temozolomide With Abexinostat (PCI-24781) for Patients With Recurrent High Grade Glioma

tumour_pk_planned_evidence.quote: characterize the pharmacokinetics (PK) of PCI-24781/Abexinostat, temozolomide, and the combination of the 2 drugs

target_engagement_planned_evidence.quote: Peripheral blood samples collected at baseline and during treatment will be analyzed for changes in acetylation of peripheral blood mononuclear cell (PBMC) histones H3 and H4.

role_evidence.quote: [DRUG] PCI 24781 (other names: Abexinostat): Participants will take PCI-24781/Abexinostat on days 1 - 4, 8 - 11, and 15 - 18 of each 28-day cycle.

Participants will additionally initiate metronomic temozolomide on Cycle 1, Day 1 at a dose of 50 mg/m2, taken by mouth twice daily and continue the PCI-24781/Abexinostat and metronomic temozolomide regimen until disease progression or intolerance.

coder_notes: Metronomic temozolomide is given to all patients in the single arm as backbone and is not itself the investigated question (dose finding is for abexinostat), so soc_backbone rather than established_therapy_experiment; adjudicator may consider rule 6. PK sample type not stated (unclear). Histone H3/H4 acetylation measured in PBMC/blood exosomes is a pharmacodynamic marker but not a tumour molecular biomarker, so not listed in biomarkers. 'Molecular profiles' correlated with response refer to PBMC/exosomes, not specified tumour markers.
